nemi.cp: fem. the rim of a wheel.
nemi.p:
[Nī+mi+ī] (thī) CL=9 Tassa cakkassa anto avasānaṃ nemi, sānārīyaṃ itthiyaṃ. Nayati cakkaṃ nemiyā bhūmiṃ phusati, nī naye, mi, īpaccaye nemi ca. Dhāna, ṭī. 373. Netīti nemi. Rū. 651] (1) Rim (a) the rim which is the edge of the chariot's wheel. (b) the rim of round of rebirth. (c) the rim of the cycle. (2) the edge (of the same wheel) (3 ) Sit Gyi tree - a kind of tree, nemi (masculine gender) [ Yadicchā noun]. (1) an ogre-deity named Nemi. (who is the reporter of Great deity Vessavaṇṇa and one of the twelve chief Ogre-deities of the state.
(2) see Nemikāla . Nemi(kri) [ni+mi]. bring, carry away. see Neti.
pn: Nemi 03. A Pacceka Buddha, perhaps the same as Nimi (q.v.). MN.iii.70.
Nemi 04. Forty-three kappas ago there were sixteen kings of this name, all previous births of Vimala Koṇḍañña. Thag-a.i.146; Ap.i.150.

nemindhara.p: [Nemi+dhara+a] (pu) CL=9 the mount Nemindhara. The mountain that carries itself, like a ridge of five mountains. The mountain which is considered as a mark of the boundary . the mountain that carries the Sit Ghi tree mostly.
pn: Nemindhara (v.l. Nimindhara). One of the seven mountain ranges round Sineru. Ja.vi.125; Vin-a.i.119; Snp-a.ii.443; Divy.217; Mvu.ii.300.

(3) Sit Gyi tree; a kind of tree.
